page.description: CachyOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An Arch-based desktop tuned for current CPUs, with its own kernel builds and package repository. One desktop image, rolling updates.
pros: Packages built for modern x86-64 CPU levels, with an Arch base.
Rolling release: no reinstall between monthly images.
Its own kernel and scheduler options are set up out of the box.
One image, so no edition matrix to choose from.
cons: Rolling updates are frequent and expected.
The version is the monthly image date (2026-08-09), not a semver release.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was available, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was available for CachyOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One path: the desktop ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The pinned image is the 2026-08-09 build.
